body:
When creating this Selenite necklace, our vision was to capture a powerful, wearable form of Selenite healing properties that you can always keep near you. For all our light workers out there, this is for you!

Selenite is one of our must-have crystals -- it's one that both Heather and Timmi wear each and every day. One of the highest vibration crystals on the planet, it infuses your mind, body and spirit with light, cleansing you of negativity and energy blocks. Wearing it creates an energetic shield of protection around your aura. It brings calming energies, deep peace and mental clarity.

Wearing Selenite jewelry, such as a necklace or bracelet, also shields and protects you from lower energy frequencies, especially energy vampires, spirits or ghosts. Selenite is a form of liquid light that infuses your aura and spirit with white light when worn or held.

The reason a Selenite crystal necklace is so powerful is because you can have constant access to the energy of your crystal. You can wear it over your heart throughout the day and even place it in specific areas of the body when needed.

Here are five benefits of wearing your Energy Clearing Necklace:

- It holds the energy of light, providing a source of healing frequencies for us to plug into.

- It purifies our energy field and allows us to clear away energetic sludge, grime, and other unwanted or negative energy.

- It provides relief from pain when placed on the body by infusing that space with high vibrational energy.

- It helps to promote energetic healing.

- It protects your energy by blocking out lower vibrations because wherever there is light, darkness cannot enter.

Wear the Energy Clearing necklace when you want to clear and protect your aura from negative energy. Let this necklace form a shield around you to keep your energy field free of low vibrational energy and filled with light each and every day.
